title: STEP2-DEMETHYL-01 non-cognate docking in the frozen 1KZK JE2 pocket
scientific_question: Can the single MOLDISC-011-selected STEP2-DEMETHYL-01 candidate execute reproducibly through the frozen 1KZK/JE2 pocket cross-docking protocol?

docking.grid_rule: derive from exact crystallographic JE2 reference coordinates using research-os.redocking.v1.1 native-ligand box rule
docking.receptor_rule: reuse REDOCK-003 ATX-007 receptor extraction: protein ATOM records from author chains A+B

primary_endpoint.name: technical completion under frozen non-cognate JE2-pocket protocol
primary_endpoint.pass_condition: exact identities, non-empty receptor and ligand PDBQT, Vina 1.2.7 return code zero, complete ordered scored pose output and complete provenance

interpretation_boundaries: Candidate selection was completed upstream in MOLDISC-011 using the declared AqSolDB rule; MOLDISC-012 does not select or rank candidates.
MOLDISC-010 docking score is explicitly excluded from candidate selection, protocol selection and success thresholding.
The receptor and grid are frozen from REDOCK-003 ATX-007 and are not tuned to the first observed MOLDISC-012 score.
No favorable-score threshold exists; the primary endpoint is reproducible technical completion.
No RMSD to native JE2 is reported because STEP2-DEMETHYL-01 and JE2 are different molecular graphs.
NON_COGNATE_HOLO_CROSSDOCKING remains PARTIALLY_VALIDATED with E2_COMPUTATIONAL evidence.
Technical completion does not establish affinity, free energy, a correct binding pose, protease inhibition, potency, efficacy, safety or clinical utility.
